body: Because it was only passing the props to a `li > a`, all logic was already handled in the `Pagination` component. I thought this was one layer too many. I don't see the value of it, could you explain?

The building we're using here is mostly the component. So if you have a something that is big enough for its own function it should go in a component.

Eventually when we move to 0.14 we can start creating function based components.
